description.text: Origins Game Fair, also called the Origins International Game Expo, is a game convention held each summer at the Greater Columbus Convention Center in Columbus, Ohio. In 2003 it hosted one of the last Pokémon events Wizards of the Coast ran, and from 2004 to 2007 the US National Championships were played there. Attendees got a card in some years: a holofoil Kyogre ex in 2003, EX Delta Species' Ditto stamped for Origins 2007, and Secret Wonders' Shellos East Sea stamped Origins Game Fair 2008, with a Staff copy as well.
